usage: tunnel pack [-h] [--base BASE] [--json] [-o OUT] file

positional arguments:
  file           the scenario JSON file to read

options:
  -h, --help     show this help message and exit
  --base BASE    where the admin API answers (default http://127.0.0.1:8000)
  --json         print raw JSON, errors included, for piping into jq
  -o, --out OUT  output file; prints to stdout when not given
